prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: The 2026-10-07 bounded MgIrH3/IrMgH3 search found a related experimentally observed Pm-3m MgIrHx phase with unknown hydrogen content, not an exact experimental superconducting MgIrH3 benchmark. The new-to-reviewed-catalogue object is the fully ordered H3 occupancy and matched Ir-for-Rh hypothesis; no first-composition claim.

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Hydrogen stoichiometry, anharmonicity and competing complex hydrides are the important physical risks. Hansen et al. observed a minor Pm-3m MgIrHx phase but could not establish x, potentially even zero; their Mg2IrH5 synthesis and proposed Mg2IrH6 superconductivity are different stoichiometries/prototypes. These priors neither establish MgIrH3 superconductivity nor invalidate the exact locally stable model. Neglected Ir SOC and different PP/cutoff between Rh and Ir remain matched-method falsifiers.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=0.108 GPa, full max stress=0.108 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ir replaces Rh on the single transition-metal site while the Mg and three H roles remain mapped. The volume rises 3.573%, with the actual H-metal and H-H distances retained below. Lambda improves at all ten sigma values, whereas the separate Eli mu=.1 change is modest, 11.198 to 11.862 K; this distinction avoids ranking solely by coupling.
proposed_contribution.next_action: At the same ordered MgIrH3/MgRhH3 geometry roles, separate common-volume chemical substitution from expansion and test H stoichiometry/anharmonic modes. A persistent direct coupling advantage without an unstable H/order branch supports screening; a stable hydrogen-deficient insulating phase or erased coupling advantage opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
